title: Reading the Unary Counter
statement: For all $n,j\in\mathbb{N}$, the unary counter tape of length $n$ contains the bit $1$ at offset $j$ if $j<n$, and is blank there if $j\ge n$.
replaced:
The unary counter tape of length $n$ holds a one at every nonnegative offset
$j < n$ and a blank at every offset $j \ge n$: its occupied cells are exactly its
unary prefix.
